projectDescription: A SQL-based analysis project using Snowflake to explore Transport for London journey volumes across six transport types from 2010 onward.
keyFeatures: Analysis of TfL journey volumes across six transport types (Bus, Underground & DLR, Overground, TfL Rail, Tram, Emirates Airline)
Monthly data from 2010 onward sourced from the Mayor of London's open data portal
Three core SQL queries answering specific business questions about journey volume trends
Snowflake-based single denormalised table design optimised for exploratory analysis
Reproducible end-to-end tutorial with expected results for each query
Recipes for common analysis tasks: null checks, pivots, YoY calculations, and seasonal slicing
Python/pandas helper for loading the raw CSV with explicit column typing
publicApiSurface: TFL.JOURNEYS table (columns: MONTH, YEAR, DAYS, REPORT_DATE, JOURNEY_TYPE, JOURNEYS_MILLIONS)
Query: most_popular_transport_types — total journeys by transport type, all-time
Query: emirates_airline_popularity — top 5 months by cable car volume
Query: least_popular_years_tube — bottom 5 years by Underground & DLR volume
tfl_journeys_final.csv — raw source extract (935 rows, 6 columns)
